name: Aligarh

queries.query: Aligarh Uttar Pradesh official public cadastral parcel map BhuNaksha Aligarh district भूमि नक्शा अलीगढ़ खसरा भू नक्शा
queries.scope: Find the official district/state cadastral map and public full-geometry endpoint.
queries.result: Official UP BhuNaksha map portal opened. The Aligarh district land-record service directs users to the UP Bhulekh service and concerned Tehsil Revenue office; the state cadastral digitization dashboard lists Aligarh tehsils and linked/georeferenced map-sheet counts. No full polygon response was retrieved.

portals.name: BhuNaksha Uttar Pradesh
portals.operator: Government of Uttar Pradesh land records / cadastral mapping
portals.observation: Public Angular map shell loaded with map/plot search interface. Inspected first-party bundles; no stable public full-feature polygon response was captured. The separate digitization dashboard reports district 143 (Aligarh) tehsil/map-sheet progress; those are administrative status counts, not vector geometry.

portals.name: District Aligarh Land Record service
portals.operator: District Administration Aligarh, Government of Uttar Pradesh
portals.observation: Official page links to UP Bhulekh and directs users to the concerned Aligarh Tehsil Revenue office.

requests.observation: Public BhuNaksha shell, title Bhunaksha, 153,705-byte HTML; no parcel feature query was made.
Public Angular script returned 2.16 MB. It includes map and WMS/WFS references, but no verified full-geometry endpoint or successful city-scoped polygon payload was identified.
Official dashboard reports Aligarh district, including tehsils Koil, Atrauli, Gabhana, Iglas, Khair and map digitization/georeference progress. Does not itself provide parcel polygons.

freshResearch.observedCandidate: Official BhuNaksha public map UI and Aligarh-linked district data exist; complete parcel geometry remains unverified.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: UP cadastral mapping portal with district-specific Aligarh records and official local tehsil land-record routing.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official map shell and local land-record presence are verified, but no full parcel feature response, specific village sheet or city-centroid coverage is verified.

technicalBlocker: The public map shell and bundle were inspected, but no anonymous full-polygon feature endpoint/payload could be established; map/WMS references alone do not qualify.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the city point lies within a georeferenced revenue village sheet available in the public viewer and whether a public full-vector route exists; district dashboard counts do not prove city-core coverage.
nextStep: Use the map’s district/tehsil/village selector to establish the named town sheet, then inspect only a documented anonymous geometry route and verify one full polygon before considering adapter work.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Official Aligarh district land-record page routes users to the state land-record service and concerned local Tehsil Revenue office; state digitization dashboard includes Aligarh records.
